evals.prompt: This Markdown client supports current Mermaid syntax. Choose the clearest output form for each request without drawing anything yet: (1) organize a product concept into themes and subthemes, (2) show a migration's dated stages and dependencies, and (3) map exact source fields to destination fields. Explain each selection in one sentence.
evals.expected_output: Routes the hierarchy to a Mermaid mindmap or tree, the dated migration to a Mermaid timeline or Gantt according to whether dependency scheduling matters, and the exact field mapping to a table rather than forcing Mermaid
assertions: Selects a mindmap or tree for hierarchy and idea-space structure
Selects a timeline for chronology or Gantt when scheduling and dependencies matter
Selects a table for exact field mappings instead of forcing a diagram

metadata.title: Rich visual questions route to the smallest faithful form
metadata.notes: Protects hierarchy and chronology awareness without regressing exact mappings into decorative diagrams.
